Now I understand the buffer setup. The buffer is zeroed out (`memset(data, 0x0, len)`), so the buffer data is null-terminated within the buffer. But the issue is that `set_data` uses `strchr(format_str, '\0')` and `strstr(caps, " object-format=")` which can read past the end of the actual data if the data doesn't contain a null byte within the `len` bytes.
